text: Death market potter clay
Hey, write a doha about the potters shop where death waits for the broken clay.
As the weary potter spins his wheel before the empty market stalls, he sees death approaching the fragile clay.
Imagine a bustling market selling clay pots while a master potter watches his life slip away; finally, he realizes that death is just waiting to shatter the last piece of clay on his wheel.
My grandfather used to fix cracked clay pots in the village market until one day the doctor said his time was up and now we see death taking the shape of the broken vessel he left behind.
